title: Vitellius
lead: Aulus Vitellius, commander of the Lower Rhine army, hailed as emperor by the German legions in the first days of January AD 69 and killed in Rome on 20 December 69.

sections.b: Galba sent him to Lower Germany; Tacitus says the appointment seemed enough because his father had been censor and three times consul (1:9). Fabius Valens pushed him to take the throne and the legions proclaimed him within days of the 1 January mutiny (1:52-57). He took the name Germanicus and refused the title Caesar (1:62). Wikipedia gives his birth as 24 September AD 15, his reign as 19 April to 20 December 69, and his death in Rome at 54.
